title: The Long Cruise
goal: Keep the crew healthy and on course through seven months of deep space.

cruise.smooth.title: MARS AHEAD
cruise.smooth.text: A small red dot grows in the window. The crew is ready for the hardest part of the trip.

cruise.strained.title: ARRIVING TIRED
cruise.strained.text: Mars is in sight, but the long trip has worn everyone down. Landing will take extra focus.

cruise.radiation.title: SOLAR STORM EXPOSURE
cruise.radiation.text: The solar storm hit before the crew could hide. Everyone is sick, and the trip is cut short.
cruise.radiation.lesson: Solar particle storms arrive fast. Real crews shelter behind water or cargo as soon as the warning comes.

cruise.missed.title: FLEW PAST MARS
cruise.missed.text: The small burn was not enough. Mars slides by in the window and the ship cannot turn around.
cruise.missed.lesson: Course corrections are cheapest when made early. Waiting makes the burn bigger.
